mode.mockNotice: DEMO · Simulated Veazy. These controls send no Bluetooth commands.
mode.liveNotice: BLUETOOTH · Controls send commands to the selected Veazy. Use the buttons below to search and connect.
status.pending: Command sent; waiting for confirmed device state.
status.stale: State is stale. Heating and temperature are unconfirmed.
connection.selectNotice: Turn on your Veazy and keep it nearby. Search, then select your device; connecting does not start heating.
temperature.measurementNotice: Veazy may provide no measured temperature. The effective target is a setting, not a measurement.
temperature.limitNotice: Until hardware validation, commands with an effective target above 210 °C are blocked. Superboost adds its own offset to the base target.
battery.label: Battery
settings.notice: Only settings read from the device are available. The charging options below are separate device settings; firmware support needs checking on your Veazy.
settings.charge_current_optimization.des: Separate charging option from the Veazy protocol.
settings.charge_voltage_limit.descriptio: Separate charging option from the Veazy protocol.
settings.boost_timeout_disabled.descript: On means the boost timeout is disabled.
settings.permanent_bluetooth.description: Keep Bluetooth available on supported Veazy firmware.
settings.find: Make Veazy give a find signal
diagnostics.notice: Raw device diagnostics. Unknown codes are not interpreted as a manufacturer diagnosis.
about.native: Native Omarchy Quickshell plugin with a separate Python/Bleak service. No browser is opened.
about.credits: Protocol based on Reactive Volcano App, created by Tristan Teufel. Source code and original protocol implementation:
about.hardware: Hardware validation on your Veazy has not been performed yet. A Bluetooth disconnection does not mean that heating is off.
keyboard.hint: Tab / Shift+Tab: choose control · Enter / Space: activate · Esc: close
